It is the constant "%06llu", which guarantees that the output will be exactly 6 digits followed by a terminating null byte. The microseconds buffer is declared with size 7, which exactly fits the 6-digit string plus the null terminator. Therefore the sprintf call cannot write more than 7 characters, eliminating the claimed stack‑based buffer overflow.
